title: heartbeat (HA to ROS)
description: Topic {prefix}/ha/heartbeat, HA to ROS, QoS 0, not retained, message expiry 5 s. Published every heartbeat_interval_s (default 2; 0 disables) and never while HA's MQTT client is disconnected. Informational on the node unless watchdog.mode says otherwise. ts feeds the node's ha_clock_offset_ms.

interval_ms.description: The configured heartbeat interval in milliseconds, so the node can size its watchdog timeout (at least 2.5 times this value).
